# BTicino C300X Integration v1.9.11

## Unreleased

## Fixed

- Send a complete 20 ms PCMU silence frame when the microphone is inactive,
  matching the RTP timestamp increment. Speex silence remains unchanged.

## Validation

- Three PCMU on-demand tests of 15, 45 and 90 seconds on a C300X passed with the
  microphone inactive, including normal 60-second session renewal. No reboot
  or firmware-process restart occurred during at least 180 seconds of
  observation after each stop. Issue #55 was closed following this validation.
- The reporter's exact cold-boot, short-gap and multi-unit setup remains
  untested with this build on their device.

## Upgrade

- Requires native agent 1.9.11 to activate the corrected PCMU silence frames.
- Updating only the integration is insufficient. No firmware patch or GUI
  change is required for this correction.
